SELECT s.Phone
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1
AND f.`Charter Funding Type` = 'Direct'
AND s.OpenDate > '2000-01-01';

SELECT s.Phone
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1
AND f.`Charter Funding Type` = 'Direct'
AND s.OpenDate > '2000-01-01';

SELECT DISTINCT T2.Phone
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1 AND T1.`Charter Funding Type` LIKE '%charter%' AND T2.OpenDate > '2000-01-01';

SELECT s.Phone
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.Charter = 1 AND f.`Charter Funding Type` = 'Direct' AND s.OpenDate > '2000-01-01';

SELECT schools.Phone
FROM schools
JOIN frpm ON schools.CDSCode = frpm.CDSCode
WHERE frpm.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1
  AND frpm.`Charter Funding Type` = 'Direct'
  AND schools.OpenDate > '2000-01-01';

SELECT schools.Phone
FROM schools
JOIN frpm ON schools.CDSCode = frpm.CDSCode
WHERE frpm.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1
  AND frpm.`Charter Funding Type` = 'Directly funded'
  AND schools.OpenDate >= '2000-01-01'
  AND schools.Phone IS NOT NULL;

SELECT s.Phone
